newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re buys stake in Alte Leipziger unit.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re buys stake in Alte Leipziger unit.

text.p: The world's leading reinsurance group Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG said on Tuesday that it had bought a stake of nearly 20 percent in fellow German insurer Alte Leipziger's international holding company.
A Munich Re spokesman said in response to a Reuter inquiry: "We will take a minority stake in the Alte Leipziger Europa Beteiligungs AG which will be nearly 20 percent."
But he could not give a price for the stake.
He said the move was prompted by the two groups' strong relations in recent years.
The Alte Leipziger Europa Beteiligungs AG holds stakes in insurance groups in seven east European nations, the spokesman said.
